@graph.name: Candor Digital
@graph.description: Melbourne-based digital marketing practice for small, ambitious brands: social and content, paid social ads, email and retention, analytics and reporting.

mainEntity.name: Isn't a brand-new agency a risk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Being new is a fair thing to weigh — so we've built the trial scope specifically to let you test that risk for four weeks and real numbers, rather than a year and a contract.

mainEntity.name: What if I only need one specific thing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Say so in the audit call. If one channel genuinely covers it, that's the whole engagement — we're not going to invent a reason to sell you a second one.

mainEntity.name: How fast will I hear back from you?

acceptedAnswer.text: Within one business day, usually sooner. Updates and reports are async by design, but a direct question gets a direct, personal answer — not a ticket number.

mainEntity.name: What happens if it isn't working?

acceptedAnswer.text: You'll hear that from us, in writing, in the very first report — along with what we think the actual problem is. No quiet renewal, no spin.

mainEntity.name: How much does social media management cost in Melbourne?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most Melbourne agencies charge somewhere between a few hundred and a few thousand dollars a month, depending on how many platforms, posts and videos are included. Our current ranges are listed in the pricing section below, and every quote follows the free audit so you only pay for the channels that make sense for your business.

mainEntity.name: How long do Meta ads take to show results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expect the first two to four weeks to be a learning phase while Meta finds the right audience. That's why our trial scope is four weeks: by the end you'll have real cost-per-result numbers to judge, not a forecast.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a big ad budget to start?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Many small businesses start with $15 to $30 a day on Meta. We'd rather prove a campaign works on a small budget and scale what's working than spend big on guesses. Ad spend is paid directly by you and never marked up.
No. Every engagement is month-to-month after the four-week trial. You can pause, change scope or stop with notice, and you keep every account, asset and report we built.

mainEntity.name: What's included in the free 30-minute audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: We review your social profiles, website, any ad accounts and your recent numbers, then tell you plainly what's working, what isn't and whether paid marketing is worth it for you right now. You leave with a short written summary, whether or not you work with us.

mainEntity.name: Do you only work with Melbourne businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: We're based in Melbourne and love working with local businesses, but everything we do works remotely, so we also take on clients across Australia.

mainEntity.name: What kinds of businesses do you work best with?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small, owner-led businesses that sell to consumers or local customers: cafes and food brands, beauty and wellness, trades and home services, mortgage brokers and finance, and online stores. If we're not the right fit, we'll say so in the audit.

mainEntity.name: Can you build or fix my website too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We design and build fast, mobile-first websites and landing pages, usually as part of a marketing engagement so the site is set up to track enquiries from day one.
